results.title: This Beautiful-but-Boring HVAC Stock Has Quietly Crushed the Market -- and Its Run Is Far From Over
results.author: Lee Samaha
results.description: Comfort Systems USA stock has surged 1,240% over three years, driven by AI data center infrastructure spending. While the company benefits from massive backlog and continued hyperscaler commitments, valuation concerns exist as PwC predicts data center spending will decline in the late 2020s while digital networking spending grows. Post-2030 growth assumptions may not materialize as spending shifts toward inference and digital networks, creating significant downside risk despite continued medium-term support.
